_README: RiboMine on LRZ CoolMUC-4 (SLURM). Submit from a login node:
This is an ordinary RiboMine config. Keys starting with '_' are comments; the
`_slurm` block is read only by slurm/master.sh. See docs/SLURM.md.
Check the three `reference` paths before the first submit (slurm/prep.sh validates them).

_slurm._: 2 jobs x 4 nodes x 112 cores = 896 cores.
_slurm._limits: cm4_std: 2-4 nodes per job, 2 jobs running at once, 24 h. Nodes have 112 physical cores and 488 GiB and are allocated exclusively.

project.name: ribomine-lrz
_workdir: Root of the run. Per-node workdirs are <workdir>/shards/work_NN; slurm/merge.sh
builds <workdir>/merged/ and writes the cohort tables there.
Disk, per run (measured on the pilot): 2.08 GB downloaded, 298 MB of BAM kept,
4.85 GB on disk while it is processed. For ~3,300 runs kept by QC: ~1.0 TB of
BAMs, plus 4.85 GB x runs in flight (8 nodes x project.jobs: ~0.55 TB at 14,
~1.1 TB at 28). FASTQs are deleted once the BAM exists.
Put it on a project filesystem (a DSS container); the home quota is too small.
_jobs: Samples in flight per node. jobs x threads may exceed the 112 physical cores, up
to the 224 hardware threads: a sample waiting on a download uses no core.
Memory: ~28 GB for the node's shared STAR genome plus roughly 8 GB per sample.
14 rather than 28, because at 28 the first (heaviest) batch ran a node out of memory.

_end: Set to 'qc' for a first screening pass: QC streams a 200k-read sample per run
instead of downloading it. Then set 'bam' and resubmit; the QC verdicts are reused.

_: Validated by slurm/prep.sh. star_index must have been built with --sjdbGTFfile,
otherwise no gene-count matrix is written.

_min_unique_frac: RiboMine's default, set explicitly because it was reviewed and kept. In the
18-run pilot this gate alone rejected 2 of the 8 runs that passed every other
test (13.2% and 6.7% uniquely mapped); with ~8,900 candidates, precision was
preferred over recall. QC verdicts are cached in qc.json, so changing this
later means re-running QC for every run.

_connections: Per run. Connections open against ENA at peak = nodes x project.jobs x this
(8 x 14 x 4 = 448); RiboMine's default is 8. Lower it first if downloads start
failing (they show up in failed.tsv and mapping_summary.tsv).
